page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7a.16xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 32 physical cores of an AMD EPYC 7T83 processor running at 2.55 GHz. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, relying instead on network-attached storage and featuring a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

Benchmark data shows strong multi-core and single-core CPU performance, placing in the top 25% of tested systems under stress-ng workloads. The instance demonstrates strong capabilities in cryptographic tasks, with Passmark encryption and extended instruction tests scoring in the top 25%. Memory performance is mixed; cached small-block read bandwidth is strong, whereas uncached large-block read and write bandwidths fall into the average range. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, ray tracing, and image processing benchmarks also register in the top 25%, while software compilation and text processing remain average.

For machine learning workloads, the instance achieves strong prompt processing and text generation speeds with small 135M parameter models, though performance drops to average with medium 7B models. Given the dedicated CPU allocation and 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the instance offers qualitative cost efficiency for compute-heavy workloads that do not require local storage or GPU acceleration. Appropriate workloads include multi-threaded data processing, database operations, cryptography, and image processing.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7a.16xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server featuring 64 dedicated vCPUs and 128.0 GB of RAM, powered by an AMD EPYC 7T83 processor at 2.55 GHz. Operating on the KVM hypervisor, this x86_64 instance provides a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio with no local storage or GPUs, and a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps. Benchmark results indicate strong multi-core CPU performance, cryptographic execution, and database operations, all placing in the top 25%. Memory bandwidth for cached small blocks is strong, though uncached large-block operations are average. The instance is suited for compute-intensive tasks such as multi-threaded decompression, cryptography, database operations, and small-scale language model inference.
